text:
Aisha: Heads up 1 Halcyon POC needs hosted API access. Security asks for rotation + instant revoke. They want a simple handoff for two devs. Can we confirm flow and deliverables? cc @sam_se @priya_security
Sam_SE: For POCs we prefer ephemeral, scoped keys. Short TTL, delivered via vault or one-time link. How long is the POC window?
Aisha: Two weeks, but devs might run overnight tests. Security wants daily rotation as an option and full auditability.
Priya_Security: Ephemeral is fine. Requirements: TTL <= 72h (24h preferred), console audit logs enabled and exported, revocation API documented, IP allowlist if customer requests, and ensure keys never shipped in frontend bundles.
Jamie_SRE: Operationally: we can create a service account that can rotate keys programmatically. Flow: 1) create ephemeral key with 48h TTL 2) deliver via one-time signed URL (TTL on URL 15m) or push to customer's secret manager 3) enable per-key quotas and IP allowlist 4) set webhook to notify infra on revocation/rotate events.
Sam_SE: CLI examples we usually give them:
```
# create ephemeral key limited to generation + embeddings
redwood keys create --type ephemeral --expires 48h --scopes generate,embed --note "halcyon-dev1"
# revoke
redwood keys revoke <key-id>
```
Also API for programmatic rotate/revoke: POST /v1/keys/:id/rotate and POST /v1/keys/:id/revoke
Aisha: Halcyon prefers not to run their own cron. Can Redwood provide a simple rotate endpoint they can call from CI?
Jamie_SRE: Yes 1 we have a rotate endpoint and a tiny Lambda example that exchanges a service account token for a fresh hosted key and writes to Vault/1Password. We'll attach link to snippet.
Infra-bot: Internal docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/keys#ephemeral (includes CLI, API, rotate lambda example, audit export setup)
Priya_Security: For the SecQ answers, include: token lifecycle policy (TTL, renewal), revocation mechanisms and SLAs for revocation, audit export locations and retention, recommended scopes for POC, and recommended handoff (1Password or signed link). I'll eyeball the draft before sending.
Aisha: I'll draft the handoff checklist and SecQ answers tonight. Plan to provision two ephemeral keys at 48h TTL and share via a signed link to Halcyon's engs.
Sam_SE: If they give office CIDRs we can lock keys to those IP ranges and set per-key rate limits. Send me the engineer names and CIDRS.
Priya_Security: Add a POC term: automatic rotation every 48h and immediate reporting of suspected compromise to security@redwood.ai. Also require keys not to be embedded into mobile or web clients.
Aisha: Will add that to the POC terms and confirm with legal.
Jamie_SRE: Note: if they later need longer-lived tokens for integration tests we can propose a Dedicated scoped token with RBAC and audit sink to their S3/KMS. For now ephemeral only.
Aisha: Thanks all. I'll post the two engineer names + CIDRS as soon as Halcyon confirms and then Sam will create the keys. :thumbsup:
Sam_SE: Roger that. I'll prepare the one-time link workflow and set TTLs.
Priya_Security: Thanks 1 I'll review the SecQ drafts once posted. :lock:
